### Comfort in the Wilderness
Author: Kristel Acevedo
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-june-9-2025.html
Passage: 1 Kings 19:5
Points:
- Elijah was emotionally and spiritually depleted after fleeing Jezebel's threats into the wilderness.
- God did not scold Elijah for his despair or demand immediate spiritual productivity.
- The Lord provided gentle care by sending an angel with simple food, water, and rest.
- In seasons of depression or burnout, receiving physical rest and nourishment is often God's first provision.

### “I’ve Had Enough”
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/i-ve-had-enough-one-year-devotions-for-men-october-26.html
Passage: 1 Kings 19:4
Points:
- Prolonged strain and valley experiences can bring even bold spiritual leaders to their breaking point.
- Elijah collapsed under a broom tree when Jezebel persisted and his physical energy was spent.
- The Lord met Elijah with tender care, nourishing his body and gently teaching him in his weakness.
- Reaching the limit of personal strength is often the place where we discover that God is enough.
